title: ricinocarpus pilosus
intro: Ricinocarpus pilosus, commonly known as Indian gentian, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory. The therapeutic actions of Ricinocarpus pilosus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, flavonoids, and glycosides, that exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
